records.issue_text: topic_embed.rb:29-33 content_sha1 is updated even when the revision fails, permanently losing the update and making embeds diverge from source forever
records.rationale: In `app/models/topic_embed.rb`, when an existing embed’s content changes (`if content_sha1 != embed.content_sha1`), the code calls `revisor.revise!(...)` and then unconditionally executes `embed.update_column(:content_sha1, content_sha1)`. There is no check that `revise!` succeeded (it can return `false` per `lib/post_revisor.rb`: `return false if not should_revise?`, and `@post.save(...)` is not checked). records.issue_text: absolutize_urls protocol-relative URL handling mangles scheme-relative hrefs (//cdn.example/x) into http://host/cdn.example/x, destroying the URL
records.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.absolutize_urls`, any `href`/`src` that `start_with?('/')` is rewritten as `"#{prefix}/#{href.sub(/^\/+/, '')}"`. This also matches protocol-relative URLs like `//cdn.example/x`: `sub(/^\/+/, '')` strips both leading slashes, producing `cdn.example/x`, yielding `http(s)://<host>/cdn.example/x` and breaking the intended scheme-relative URL.

records.issue_text: Resize messages silently ignored for older browsers where e.origin is undefined (indexOf coerces to 'undefined'), leaving the iframe clipped with no fallback height
records.rationale:
In `app/assets/javascripts/embed.js`, the message handler relies on `e.origin`:
```js
if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }
```
If `e.origin` is undefined (as the finding notes can happen in some older implementations), `indexOf(undefined)` searches for the string "undefined" and returns `-1`, causing the handler to return early and skip resizing. Since the iframe is created without an explicit `height` and is only resized via this message (`iframe.height = ...`), resize messages would be ignored and the iframe can remain at an incorrect/clipped height with no fallback.
